verdict.rationale: Postman's Agent Mode/Postbot is documented to generate and update tests via natural language directly from requests/responses ('ask Agent Mode to add tests to requests', 'fix errors, update tests'), directly matching the AI-native test/assertion generation story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of AI-generated test quality, and explicit documentation of generating tests directly from an OpenAPI/API spec rather than just live requests.
